name: citizen-resolver-system
description: Citizen Resolver System – civic issue reporting platform (monorepo root)

scripts.dev: concurrently --names "server,client" --prefix-colors "cyan,magenta" "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.start: concurrently --names "server,client" --prefix-colors "cyan,magenta" "npm run start --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
